title: Spicy Stir-Fried Dried Squid (Jinmichae Bokkeum)
summary: Tender dried squid strips coated in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce, a classic Korean rice side dish.

steps.description: Cut 120g of dried shredded squid into 5–6cm lengths with kitchen scissors, separating any tangled clumps.
Put the squid in a bowl, add 1 tbsp mayonnaise, toss to coat evenly, and let sit for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp oligosaccharide syrup, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1/2 tsp minced garlic, and 2 tbsp water to make the sauce.
Warm 1 tsp cooking oil in a pan over low heat. Add the sauce and stir gently for 30–60 seconds, until it just begins to bubble.
Turn off the heat. Add the mayonnaise-coated squid and toss until evenly covered with sauce. If needed, return to very low heat and stir-fry for only 20–30 seconds to help the sauce coat the squid.
Stir in 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, then finish with 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds.
